Details Product Quick Look 【Bluetooth 5.0 USB Dongle for Windows PC】 Embedded with the advanced Bluetooth 5.0 technology, this Bluetooth adaper for PC supports Windows 10 system for music streaming, skype calls and data transfer. 【Bluetooth Enable your Windows PC】 For Windows 10 laptop or desktop computers. Avantree DG45 USB bluetooth adapter makes your non-Bluetooth computer Bluetooth capable so you can wirelessly connect to a host of different Bluetooth peripherals. NOT compatible with Mac, Linux, TV or Car stereo systems. 【APTX SOUND QUALITY & GREAT FOR CALLS】 High performance, non-destructive compression algorithm delivers CD-like quality audio. With aptX audio you can listen to music stored locally, or stream from your favorite media service without compromising sound quality. Market-leading Qualcomm QCC3026 chip with background noise suppression, advanced true wireless 4-microphone technology and antenna optimization work seamlessly together, allowing you to converse and hear clearly through both earbuds. 【EASY TO USE INTERFACE】 Simply open the charging case to automatically turn on earbuds, connect to your device and start listening to music. Automatically powers off and starts charging when returned to the case. Freely use EITHER (L or R) earbud independently as a mono device if preferred, unlike many other similar products which allow only one fixed earbud for mono use. Also featuring convenient and easy-to-use “touch & slide”, capacitive touch controls. 【SUPPORTS QUICK CHARGE】 Running low on battery? No need to worry - a quick 10 minute charge will provide up to one hour of play time. Listen to music for up to an incredible 8 hours on one charge. Together with the convenient, portable charging case, enjoy up to 36 hours of extended total playtime.
